variations.reading_hi: Budh parvat par saaf, gehri vivah rekha — jeevan mein ek sachcha, pakka bandhan likha hai. Prachin niyam: sirf spashth rekha hi vivah/sthayi union ko darshati hai. Mercury ke mount par marriage lines ki taadad rishton aur zindagi mein important connections ki suchna deti hai. Jab widow line bhi saath ho to yeh multiple partnerships ka sanket de sakti hai — warna yeh strong emotional connections ko darshaati hai.

qualified.text_hi: Cheiro ka khud ka cross-verification niyam: prabhav rekha bhagya rekha se MAJBOOTI se milti hai, aur usi daur ki saaf vivah rekha bhi maujood hai — toh vivah ki timing sabse zyada bharose se batayi ja sakti hai. Jis umra par milan hai (bhagya rekha ke scale par), wahi aapke union ka window hai.

variations.reading_hi: Chhoti-halki rekhayein — gehri mohabbat ya aisa rishta jo vivah ki dehleez tak aaya par usme badla nahi. Har halki rekha ek aisi kahani hai jo adhoori rahi — yeh dil ki gehrai dikhati hai, kami nahi. Haath ki bahari taraf se Mercury mount tak jaane wali choti aur faint lines rishton mein kuch complexity ka sanket de sakti hain. Yeh sthayi nahi hai — in patterns ko samajhna aur rishton mein conscious effort karna bahut kaam aata hai. Yeh ek tendency hai, koi naseeb nahi. (2 classical sources is baat par sehmat hain.)
